title: Experimental Condition
description: An experimental condition that a biological sample was exposed to, such as a stimulation, a chemical or protein treatment, or a diet. The condition lists the agents involved as controlled terms, and can carry a time point range and a human-readable description.

controlled_terms.title: Controlled Terms
controlled_terms.description: Ontology terms for the agents or factors making up this condition: ChEBI terms for chemicals, UniProt terms for proteins and antibodies, and EFO terms for diets and similar factors.
controlled_terms.comment: See controlled_term.json for available identifiers. Either controlled_terms or description is required.

items.title: Controlled Term
items.description: Ontology term for an agent or factor in this condition.

lower_bound_time_point.title: Lower Bound Time Point
lower_bound_time_point.description: Lower bound of the time elapsed from the start of this condition to sample collection, in the units given by time_point_units. When the time point is known as a single value rather than an uncertain range, set this to the same number as upper_bound_time_point. lower_bound_time_point must be less than or equal to upper_bound_time_point.
lower_bound_time_point.comment: This property is affected by dependencies. See dependentSchemas.

upper_bound_time_point.title: Upper Bound Time Point
upper_bound_time_point.description: Upper bound of the time elapsed from the start of this condition to sample collection, in the units given by time_point_units. When the time point is known as a single value rather than an uncertain range, set this to the same number as lower_bound_time_point. upper_bound_time_point must be greater than or equal to lower_bound_time_point.
upper_bound_time_point.comment: This property is affected by dependencies. See dependentSchemas.

time_point_units.title: Time Point Units
time_point_units.comment: This property is affected by dependencies. See dependentSchemas.
